monster.description: A hostile combat creature or enemy character that can be attacked.
positive_clues: hostile health bar or enemy combat UI
attacks, chases, surrounds, or threatens the player
combat creature silhouette or enemy pack behavior
negative_clues: stationary town character with dialog or interaction marker
ground loot label or loot beam

npc.description: A non-hostile character intended for dialog, service, quest, or interaction.
positive_clues: dialog, quest, vendor, or interaction indicator
non-combat behavior near towns or safe areas

player.description: The controlled player character or another player/ally character.
positive_clues: character associated with player HUD or party/ally presentation
persistent controlled character near the gameplay focus

item.description: Loot or another collectible object, usually on the ground.
positive_clues: ground item name or loot label
loot beam, glow, rarity presentation, or pickup presentation
not shaped or behaving like an active character

obstacle.description: Static environment geometry or an object that blocks or constrains movement.
positive_clues: wall, pillar, barricade, rock, terrain object, or static prop
does not behave like a character or collectible

unknown.description: Use when the visual evidence is insufficient or conflicting.

relation_rules.hostile: Use only with concrete enemy or attack/combat evidence.
relation_rules.friendly: Use for the player, allies, or clearly friendly characters.
relation_rules.neutral: Use for NPCs, items, obstacles, and non-hostile entities unless stronger evidence exists.
relation_rules.unknown: Use when relation cannot be established visually.

required_evidence: at least one object classified hostile with sufficient confidence

INTERACT.meaning: Interact with an NPC, item, or explicit interaction target/UI.
required_evidence: a visible NPC/item/interactable object, or a clear interaction/pickup/dialog UI prompt
forbidden_when: no interactable object or interaction UI evidence exists

USE_RESOURCE.meaning: Use a potion or other limited resource because current state requires it.
required_evidence: HUD/state indicates a configured resource-use condition
forbidden_when: there is no resource need supported by HUD/state

required_evidence: hostile/danger evidence plus a reason to disengage such as low HP

MOVE.meaning: Move toward a concrete navigation or tactical target.
required_evidence: a concrete destination, target, or navigation reason

EXPLORE.meaning: No immediate combat/interaction requirement; continue searching the scene.
required_evidence: default safe choice when no stronger grounded intent is supported

WAIT.meaning: Do nothing temporarily when acting would be unsupported or unsafe.
required_evidence: uncertain scene or no safe useful action
